rootCause: Canonical signal and tenant impact/action candidates were shown separately, without exact signal_key matching, source state and tenant-specific next step on the same card.
fix: Tenant-scoped advice derived from current authenticated authority only; unknown financial impact remains null; source freshness never inherited from snapshot refresh; canonical review is never displayed as assigned customer action.
prevention: Always join action suggestions to the exact observed signal_key and tenant projection scope
Never promote general market signals into company impact without SCORED company_impacts evidence
Never display expected value as realized revenue
Never claim source visitation on the basis of catalogued source status or snapshot freshness
Keep absolute HTTPS source URLs, reject untrusted link schemes
Every release requires exact-head Required/CodeQL, protected merge and independent authenticated production readback
nextVerification: Check Netlify deploy SHA equals protected merge SHA
Authenticated portal readback for scored and unscored tenants
Check existing daily source cadence and independently measured customer outcomes
learningBoundary: Code/test success is not production or revenue success; source catalogue availability is not daily crawl evidence.
